title: New upgrades every flight | Beyond Orbit
caption: Every level up offers three upgrades for this flight only. Afterburner, Rapid Cycler, Nano Repair, Targeting Optics. Which one do you pick?
No two flights play the same. Level up, pick one of three upgrades and build a different ship every run.
